latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the "Editor Change — Switch Editing Style, Export Video" skill.
- Upload an existing video (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM up to 500MB) and describe how you want it re-edited.
- Instantly switch editing styles (e.g., from jump cuts to smooth transitions with music) and export the result in 1–2 minutes.
- Automatic setup and authentication with 100 free credits for new users.
- Clearly structured cloud processing pipeline, status handling, and easy export/download of re-edited videos.
